entities.name: Query NDH subunit 1
observations: The 363-residue sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed Solanum lycopersicum NAD(P)H-quinone oxidoreductase subunit 1, accession Q2MI45.
The protein is predicted to be a highly hydrophobic multi-pass membrane protein; calculated molecular mass is 39,938.6 Da and theoretical pI is 4.95.
Pfam NADHdh domain PF00146.27 spans residues 33–355 with i-Evalue 9.5e-111.

entities.name: Q2MI45
observations: Reviewed Solanum lycopersicum chloroplast NAD(P)H-quinone oxidoreductase subunit 1; exact sequence hash match to the query.
Localized to the chloroplast thylakoid membrane and annotated as a multi-pass membrane component of the NDH complex.
The chloroplast NDH complex transfers electrons from NAD(P)H toward plastoquinone through FMN and Fe-S-containing components and couples this process to proton translocation.

entities.name: Chloroplast NDH complex
observations: Plant chloroplast NDH is composed of at least 16 subunits, including multiple membrane components and five nuclear-encoded subunits according to the reviewed reference annotation.
